quotes.text:
Any Backgammon players on here?

For those unfamiliar: Backgammon is a 5,000-year-old game that sits in an interesting space between pure skill (like chess) and pure chance (like poker). The dice introduce enough variance that a novice can occasionally beat a grandmaster, but over sufficient iterations, skill dominates completely. It's why backgammon has always been played for money – the doubling cube is literally built into the game's rules.

Despite this, there's never been a legitimate peer-to-peer platform for real-money backgammon in the US. You either play on sketchy offshore sites or meet strangers with cash at clubs. With skill-based gaming laws evolving (prediction markets, DFS, etc.), we saw an obvious gap.

What we built:
Backgammon Cash is an iOS app for head-to-head real-money matches. Key technical challenges we solved:

- Skill-based matchmaking using Elo-style ratings to keep games competitive (paired with analyzing users' skill level by checking performance)
- Verifiable random number generation for dice (with player-accessible stats)
- Anti-cheat detection for move timing and pattern analysis
- Integration with regulated payment processors (GIDX) and banking partners for deposits/withdrawals
- State synchronization for real-time gameplay without exploitable lag
